commits.head: calc: tidy the range loop, the bounds check and the mean

defects.title: range_sum drops the end element: range(start, end) excludes the inclusive end (off-by-one)
the bounds check lets end == len(values) through (> instead of >=), so an out-of-range end is summed instead of raising IndexError
mean uses floor division (//), so the mean of [1, 2] is 1, not 1.5
